description: Compare fixed-bandwidth (按带宽) cost across clouds: the monthly USD cost of an N-Mbps public pipe from a region, tier-accumulated ($/Mbps is tiered, typically flat to 5 Mbps then steeper). charge_type 'subscription' (包月, default) or 'on_demand' (按量按小时, scaled ×730 to a month so both compare on one axis). This is the alternative to pay-by-traffic (compare_egress): a fixed pipe is cheaper for steady high-throughput, egress for bursty/low volume. Filter by provider/region/country/continent/near; cheapest first.

charge_type.description: 'subscription' (monthly, default) or 'on_demand' (hourly, scaled to a month)

continent.description: NA, SA, EU, AS, AF, or OC

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, SG

mbps.description: fixed bandwidth in Mbps to price (default 100)

near.description: free-text place to find nearby regions, e.g. Singapore

name: compare_bandwidth
title: Compare fixed bandwidth cost
